ai_actions.title: AI Actions
ai_actions.desc: Prompts that run on your own Claude, with your connectors and skills, and come back as an HTML report. Run one now or put it on a schedule. Each action keeps its latest report.

empty.title: No AI actions yet
empty.body: An action is a title and a prompt, for example a skill like /dx-github-prs. Run it whenever you like, or on a schedule.

run_arguments.label: Arguments for this run
run_arguments.hint: Added after the prompt for this run only, e.g. 14 runs “{{prompt}} 14”. Scheduled runs use the prompt as is.

runner.offline_body: Actions run on your own claude CLI, because that's where your claude.ai connectors and skills are. Start the runner on this machine. Until then, runs wait in the queue.
runner.offline_queued_one: {{count}} run is waiting. Actions run on your own claude CLI, because that's where your claude.ai connectors and skills are. Start the runner on this machine to pick it up.
runner.offline_queued_other: {{count}} runs are waiting. Actions run on your own claude CLI, because that's where your claude.ai connectors and skills are. Start the runner on this machine to pick them up.

dialog.description: Write the prompt you'd type into Claude. Shire adds the report instructions, so the run always comes back as one HTML page.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.description: A slash command for one of your skills (/dx-github-prs), or plain instructions. If a skill has its own HTML template, the report follows it.

custom_schedule.label: Custom schedule
custom_schedule.description: cron:<expression> or every:<N>m / every:<N>h (15 minutes at the least). Times use your browser's timezone.

shell.label: Allow shell commands
shell.on: The run can use the shell (Bash) on this machine. Skills often need it for dates and repo lists. Opening a browser is always blocked.
shell.off: No shell. The run can only use your connectors and read files.

form.read_only_note: Runs are read-only: connector tools that create, edit, post, comment or delete are switched off.

view.queued: Queued. Waiting for the host runner to pick it up.
view.text_fallback: The run returned text instead of HTML
view.no_report_body: Run the action to get its first report. Only the latest report is kept.

delete.title: Delete this action?
delete.description: “{{title}}” and its latest report will be deleted. A queued run is cancelled.
